evan: Heads-up: planning a focused least-priv run in staging Friday 07:15 PT. Objective: prune stale admin roles, validate KMS grant orchestration, and confirm we can replay audit-proxy without gaps. Plan below.

paula: Good. Please enumerate the canary apps and precise abort criteria.

evAN: Canary apps: tenants-api, syncer, metrics-exporter. Abort if any app shows >0.4% 401s sustained 2m OR if audit replay omits any kms grant ops in the window. Also abort on >3 pod restarts in 5m.

kube-bot: creating immutable snapshot. artifact: s3://sec-dryruns/snap-4771234567.tar.gz snapshot id snap-4771234567.

evan: Owner-finder heuristic: owner tag -> onboard ticket assignee -> last-auth within 180d. If ambiguous, enqueue for manual review. Exclude keys with external grantees.

ops-bot: preflight export complete. checksum sha256:6f1ed002ab5595859014ebf0951522d9

evan: KMS test commands (staging):
```
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/stg-tenant-key --grant-id g-abc123
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/stg-tenant-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stg-tenant-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

paula: I'll watch CloudTrail + audit-proxy playback for RevokeGrant/CreateGrant/RetireGrant. If playback misses an event, save raw logs and open SEC ticket.

sec-oncall: I'll monitor token refresh rates and pod restarts. Threshold alerts: token err >0.4% or restarts >3/5m.

evan: Canary running now. React with :eyes: if you're watching.

paula: :eyes: watching tenants-api traces
sec-oncall: watching infra metrics and will post alerts.

ops-bot: KMS op in progress kms-op-477123-A.

evan: Canary complete. Observations: tenants-api had two brief 401 spikes (0.22% peak) during revoke window; both resolved after re-create + single pod restart. audit-proxy & CloudTrail show matching RevokeGrant/CreateGrant events for alias/stg-tenant-key. No missing events in playback. Skipped 4 keys with cross-account grantees (manual review).

paula: Nice. Next: schedule two more staggered staging passes, then propose prod sweep in 15m windows. Add a short blameless FYI for support describing transient 401 pattern and recovery steps (recreate grant + restart).

evan: Will open RFC-SEC-778 and attach artifacts + rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood/sec/entitlement-rollback. Thanks all.
